<b>Vaultkeepers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are [[Keepers|high caste]] bugs who are responsible for delivering sermons and leading prayer in the [[Whispering Vaults]].<ref>Vaultkeeper [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"High caste bug, responsible for delivering sermons and leading prayer for those beyond the walls of the Whispering Vaults."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Vaultkeepers often hang from the ceiling or pop out of the background, dropping down once Hornet draws near.
Vaultkeepers behave very erratically and can be very unpredictable, and have 4 moves to choose from:
* <b>Skitter:</b> Walks a set distance either left or right.
* <b>Jump:</b> Jumps up, often attempting to land either on Hornet or very close to her; alternatively, they use this move to jump entirely away from her.
** Vaultkeepers will repeatedly use this move to platform over obstacles and get to Hornet if she is on a different elevation than them.
* <b>Lunge Claw:</b> Moves backwards a short distance before lunging forward with a single strike with their claws. Often immediately follows this move up with Charging Slashes.
* <b>Charging Slashes:</b> Primes its claws and then rushes towards Hornet whilst slashing wildly in front of itself, Comboing her for {{Damage|1+1}} if she is caught at any point during the slashes. Ends the move if Hornet gets behind it or it reaches a wall.

Vaultkeepers deal {{Damage|1}} with Lunge Claw and on contact.

Simply attacking as soon as they end a move like Jump or jumping behind them after Charging Slashes are the main modes of counterplay. Attempting to predict their next move is often useless due to Vaultkeepers' erratic movement.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Vaultkeepers have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Vaultkeepers can be found in the [[Whispering Vaults]]. One is fought in the [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)/Whispering_Vaults_1|enemy gauntlet]] at the entrance to the area, and two more can be encountered in the [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)/Whispering_Vaults_2|optional gauntlet]] that reuses this arena.

The Vaultkeeper in the north-eastern room only starts to spawn once Hornet approaches the [[Silkeater]] cocoon hidden behind a breakable wall there.

== Creation and Development ==
[[File:Enemy 163 164 165.png|thumb|220px|First reveal image]]
Vaultkeepers, alongside [[Scrollreader]]s and [[Lampbearer]]s, were first revealed in a blog post released in December 2019, where their silhouette was shown. [[Team Cherry]] described them as being in a <i>"tough later game trio who, when in battle, work closely together, covering for each other's weaknesses."</i><ref>[https://www.teamcherry.com.au/blog/11xf7azcuebhybgossfhdc0mphiqbs Team Cherry blog post] of December 13th, 2019</ref> 

In the final release of the game, these three enemies do not specifically work together.

Vaultkeepers were also originally planned to be able to be struck in their shelled form; currently, they can only be struck in their shell-less form.<ref>[[:File:Vaultkeeper Cut Sprites.png|Vaultkeeper Cut Sprites]]</ref>
